sentences.text: Shri Akash Rathi, Advocate for the appellant.
Ms. Aarti Kumawat, Panel Lawyer for the respondent/Sta None for the victim.
Heard on the question of admission.
Appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A. No.6551/2023, which is first application filed under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant - Rajesh.

2 . Learned Trial Court has convicted the appellant under Sections 341, 342, 363, 366, 376(1) and 506-II of IPC alongwith 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced him to undergo SI for 01 month with fine of Rs.500/-, RI for 06 months with fine of Rs.1,000/-, nil,
RI for 05 years with fine of Rs.2,500/-, RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.5,000/-, RI for 01 year with fine of Rs.1,000/- and nil respectively with default stipulations, vide judgement of conviction and order of sentence dated 07.12.2022 passed by the Special Judge, POCSO Act, Mandleshwar, West Nimar in Case No.SC/49/2019.
3.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As per prosecution case, at the time of incident, prosecutrix was aged about 16 years 7 months.
On 31.01.2019, at around 10.00 PM, appellant forcibly took the prosecutrix to an agricultural field and committed rape upon her.
4 . Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.
There are material omissions and contradictions in the statement of prosecutrix.
Learned Trial Court has wrongly relied upon her sole statement.
Her statement is also not supported by medical evidence as well as FSL report.
During trial, appellant was on bail and after conviction, he is in custody since 07.12.2022.

Final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future therefore, it is prayed that the remaining jail sentence of appellant may be Rajesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50217477/
1 suspended and he be released on bail.

entities.text: Rajesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State has objected the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application.

6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
7.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, coupled with the fact that final disposal of this appeal is not possible in near future, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
I.A.No.6551/2023 is allowed and jail sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended.

8. It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not deposited, appellant shall be released on bail, on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) alongwith a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court firstly on 06.11.2023, and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard, till final disposal of this appeal.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE gp Rajesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50217477/
